summary: Implement PLATES-CORE marker parser, validator, conservative local-preservation merge, and diagnostics in plate_core for safe upstream sync of tool-owned sections.
migration_impact: Repos using PLATES-CORE:BEGIN/END (or simple) markers in AGENTS.md, configs, or code can now leverage plate_core runtime (and future gh plate / MCP surfaces) for deterministic syncs that preserve local edits outside markers while incorporating upstream updates inside them.
migration_guidance: 1. No immediate action for most downstream repos; the runtime enables future `plate` sync commands.
2. When authoring new PLATES-CORE blocks, follow the documented BEGIN/END syntax and uniqueness rules.
3. Existing marked blocks in forks continue to work; the conservative merge prefers local on conflict.
agent_notes: Use markers.find_marked_sections / validate_marker_nesting / merge_with_diagnostics (or the _compat) for any tooling that needs to reason about or perform marker-aware merges. Duplicate names and true nesting are now rejected at validation time. Real AGENTS.md and similar self-describing docs with literal examples are tolerated.
